reviewNotes: Twenty-five soundtrack, Desert Trader, footwear, furniture, volcano-shop, jukebox, fish-tank, and interface strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established Junimo Kart and item names, gendered honorifics, neutral traveler wording, placement rules, character voice, placeholders, punctuation, and natural Romanian interface phrasing; both found no remaining objective issue.

DesertTrader4_male.source: The camel seems to like you, sir. That is indeed a very good sign.
DesertTrader4_male.translation: Cămila pare să vă placă, domnule. Acesta este într-adevăr un semn foarte bun.

DesertTrader4_female.source: The camel seems to like you, miss. That is indeed a very good sign.
DesertTrader4_female.translation: Cămila pare să vă placă, domnișoară. Acesta este într-adevăr un semn foarte bun.

DesertTrader3.source: Your coin has no value where I come from... Do you have anything else to trade?
DesertTrader3.translation: Moneda ta nu are nicio valoare acolo de unde vin... Ai altceva de oferit la schimb?

DesertTrader1.source: Welcome, traveler... interested in making a trade?
DesertTrader1.translation: Bine ai venit... te interesează un schimb?

Ostrich_Description.source: Adult ostriches will lay a very large egg once a week.
Ostrich_Description.translation: Struții adulți depun câte un ou foarte mare o dată pe săptămână.

Object.cs.13060_Fruit.source: Too close to a fruit tree
Object.cs.13060_Fruit.translation: Prea aproape de un pom fructifer

VolcanoShop0.source: A human who speaks our language? I'm impressed...
VolcanoShop0.translation: Un om care ne vorbește limba? M-ai impresionat...

VolcanoShop1.source: Please, stay and rest. There are no monsters here.
VolcanoShop1.translation: Te rog, rămâi și odihnește-te. Aici nu sunt monștri.

VolcanoShop2.source: I haven't seen a human here for many years...
VolcanoShop2.translation: Nu am mai văzut vreun om aici de mulți ani...

VolcanoShop3.source: You are very brave to come here. Please, peruse my stock.
VolcanoShop3.translation: Ai mult curaj să vii aici. Te rog, aruncă o privire peste marfa mea.

VolcanoShop4.source: This mountain was the home of my ancestors. Now we live in the ruins of their great civilization.
VolcanoShop4.translation: Muntele acesta a fost căminul strămoșilor mei. Acum trăim printre ruinele măreței lor civilizații.

FishTank_Full.source: You cannot add any more items of this type
FishTank_Full.translation: Nu mai poți adăuga obiecte de acest tip
